key.name: show-cpu
key.description: A small ring in the top bar that fills up as the processor gets busier.

key.name: show-memory
key.description: A small ring in the top bar that fills up as memory is used.

key.name: show-temperature
key.description: Turns amber above 75 °C and red above 85 °C. Hidden on machines without a readable sensor.

key.name: show-network
key.description: Download and upload speed in the top bar. Always available in the menu.

key.name: music-visuals
key.description: Show music visuals while a media player is playing. While off, or while nothing plays, no process runs and no sound is read.

key.name: music-style
key.description: "bars": ten small bars next to the rings. "strip": a thin row of pixels along the whole top bar, in the palette's colours. "both": the two together.

key.name: music-fps
key.description: Each update makes GNOME Shell redraw part of the top bar, so higher values look smoother and use more processor time.

key.name: palette
key.description: Colours of the rings and music bars. "mono" follows the top bar's text colour.
